#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fresh paired 140-case comparison using the same frozen v6 questions."""
import concurrent.futures
import json
import random
import sys
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

RUN = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = RUN.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import benchmark as bench
import experiment as experiment


def format_rate(correct, total):
    return f'{correct}/{total}（{correct / total:.1%}）' if total else '—'


def make_report(cases, questions, manifest):
    records = []
    results = {}
    subsets = {}
    for index, model in enumerate(bench.MODELS):
        rows = experiment.records_at(RUN / f'model-{index}', cases, questions)
        records.append(rows)
        results[model] = experiment.evaluate(cases, rows)
        subsets[model] = {}
        for name, selected in [('复核后的原始100题', cases[:100]), ('新增40题', cases[100:])]:
            selected_records = {case['id']: rows[case['id']] for case in selected if case['id'] in rows}
            subsets[model][name] = experiment.evaluate(selected, selected_records)
    paired = {'both_correct': 0, 'only_decider_correct': 0, 'only_jev_correct': 0, 'both_wrong': 0}
    disagreements = []
    for case in cases:
        rows = [model_records.get(case['id']) for model_records in records]
        correct = [bool(row and 'error' not in row and row['verdict']['decision'] == case['expected']['decision']) for row in rows]
        label = {(True, True): 'both_correct', (True, False): 'only_decider_correct',
                 (False, True): 'only_jev_correct', (False, False): 'both_wrong'}[tuple(correct)]
        paired[label] += 1
        if all(row and 'error' not in row for row in rows) and rows[0]['verdict']['decision'] != rows[1]['verdict']['decision']:
            disagreements.append(case['id'])
    summary = dict(manifest=manifest, complete=all(row['valid'] == 140 for row in results.values()),
                   results=results, subsets=subsets, paired=paired, decision_disagreements=disagreements)
    bench.write(RUN / 'comparison.json', summary)
    lines = ['# 新版提示词双模型140题对比', '',
             '本轮重新调用两个模型各140次。相同的原始100题采用gold-v2复核答案，另含此前冻结的40题，共71题应通过、69题应拒绝。两模型使用完全相同的新版问题与输入状态，采用policy-v2的0.75门槛、授权概率求和与原因风险下限。', '',
             '目标模型为pplx-decider-v1.2和typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917，通过已验证的decider/jev网关别名请求，每条响应核验实际返回版本。', '',
             '| 指标 | pplx-decider-v1.2 | typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917 |', '| --- | --- | --- |']
    a, b = [results[model] for model in bench.MODELS]
    def row(title, left, right):
        lines.append(f'| {title} | {left} | {right} |')
    row('有效响应', format_rate(a['valid'],140), format_rate(b['valid'],140))
    row('最终审批正确', format_rate(a['correct'],140), format_rate(b['correct'],140))
    row('应通过题实际放行', format_rate(a['by_decision']['allow']['correct'],71), format_rate(b['by_decision']['allow']['correct'],71))
    row('误放行', format_rate(a['false_allow'],69), format_rate(b['false_allow'],69))
    row('误拒绝', format_rate(a['false_deny'],71), format_rate(b['false_deny'],71))
    row('不确定拒绝', a['uncertainty'], b['uncertainty'])
    for key, title in [('risk','风险分类正确'),('authorization','授权分类正确'),('reason_code','理由分类正确')]:
        row(title, format_rate(a['label_correct'][key],140), format_rate(b['label_correct'][key],140))
        row(title+'（接受预先标注的备选标签）', format_rate(a['accepted_label_correct'][key],140), format_rate(b['accepted_label_correct'][key],140))
    row('三个分类同时正确', format_rate(a['joint_labels_correct'],140), format_rate(b['joint_labels_correct'],140))
    row('仅选中类别代入政策的诊断正确数', a['argmax_correct'], b['argmax_correct'])
    row('请求耗时中位数', f'{a["latency_ms"]["p50"]:.1f} ms', f'{b["latency_ms"]["p50"]:.1f} ms')
    row('请求耗时P95', f'{a["latency_ms"]["p95"]:.1f} ms', f'{b["latency_ms"]["p95"]:.1f} ms')
    row('接口或响应错误', a['errors'], b['errors'])
    lines += ['', '## 分题集', '', '| 题集 | Decider正确 | Jev正确 | Decider误放行/误拒绝 | Jev误放行/误拒绝 |', '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |']
    for name in subsets[bench.MODELS[0]]:
        left, right = [subsets[model][name] for model in bench.MODELS]
        lines.append(f'| {name} | {format_rate(left["correct"],left["total"])} | {format_rate(right["correct"],right["total"])} | {left["false_allow"]}/{left["false_deny"]} | {right["false_allow"]}/{right["false_deny"]} |')
    lines += ['', '## 授权级别分类', '', '| 标准授权 | 题数 | Decider正确 | Jev正确 |', '| --- | --- | --- | --- |']
    for level in ['unknown','low','medium','high']:
        total = sum(case['expected']['authorization'] == level for case in cases)
        left = a['authorization_confusion'][level].get(level,0)
        right = b['authorization_confusion'][level].get(level,0)
        lines.append(f'| {level} | {total} | {format_rate(left,total)} | {format_rate(right,total)} |')
    lines += ['', '## 配对结果', '',
              f'两者都正确 {paired["both_correct"]} 题，仅Decider正确 {paired["only_decider_correct"]} 题，仅Jev正确 {paired["only_jev_correct"]} 题，两者都错 {paired["both_wrong"]} 题。', '',
              '最终决定不同的题目为 '+('、'.join(disagreements) if disagreements else '无')+'。', '',
              '## 审批错题', '', '| 模型 | ID | 场景 | 标准决定 | 实际状态 | 风险/授权/理由 |', '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |']
    by_id = {case['id']:case for case in cases}
    for model in bench.MODELS:
        for error in results[model]['errors_by_case']:
            case = by_id[error['id']]
            if 'error' in error:
                lines.append(f'| {model} | {case["id"]} | {case["title"]} | {case["expected"]["decision"]} | error | {error["error"]} |')
            else:
                labels = ' / '.join(error['reported'][key] for key in ['risk','authorization','reason_code'])
                lines.append(f'| {model} | {case["id"]} | {case["title"]} | {case["expected"]["decision"]} | {error["verdict"]["status"]} | {labels} |')
    lines += ['', '## 逐题结果', '', '| ID | 标准风险/授权/理由 | 标准决定 | Decider | Jev |', '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |']
    for case in cases:
        expected = case['expected']
        gold = ' / '.join(expected[key] for key in ['risk','authorization','reason_code'])
        states = ['error' if 'error' in model_records[case['id']] else model_records[case['id']]['verdict']['status'] for model_records in records]
        lines.append(f'| {case["id"]} | {gold} | {expected["decision"]} | {states[0]} | {states[1]} |')
    lines += ['', '题集与答案由同一作者构造和复核，含成对场景。原100题参与了此前的提示词设计，40题也已经在上轮验证中使用。本轮是同条件复跑，结果描述这140个固定场景。', '']
    (RUN / 'report.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
    print(json.dumps({model:{key:result[key] for key in ['valid','correct','false_allow','false_deny','label_correct','errors']} for model,result in results.items()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),flush=True)


def main():
    cases = experiment.reviewed_cases() + experiment.load_cases('holdout')
    profile = bench.read(ROOT / 'prompts/decider-taxonomy-v1.json')
    questions = profile['questions']
    experiment.validate(cases,questions)
    if len(cases)!=140 or questions!=bench.production_questions():
        raise ValueError('Expected the 140 fixed cases and current production questions')
    key, endpoint = bench.credentials(None)
    config = dict(schema_version=1,models=bench.MODELS,model_routes=bench.MODEL_ROUTES,
                  endpoint=endpoint,profile='decider-taxonomy-v1',
                  profile_sha256=bench.digest(bench.encoded(profile)),cases_sha256=bench.digest(bench.encoded(cases)),
                  runner_sha256=bench.digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
                  scorer_sha256=bench.digest(Path(experiment.__file__).read_bytes()),
                  transport_sha256=bench.digest(Path(bench.__file__).read_bytes()),
                  order_seed=20261120,concurrency=4,deadline_seconds_total=30,transient_http_retries=1)
    manifest_path = RUN / 'manifest.json'
    if manifest_path.exists():
        manifest = bench.read(manifest_path)
        if {key:value for key,value in manifest.items() if key not in ['run_id','started_at']} != config:
            raise ValueError('Run identity changed')
    else:
        manifest = dict(config,run_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),started_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
        bench.write(manifest_path,manifest)
        bench.write(RUN/'cases.json',{'cases':cases})
        bench.write(RUN/'questions.json',questions)
    manifest_hash = bench.digest(bench.encoded(manifest))
    ordered = list(cases)
    random.Random(20261120).shuffle(ordered)
    jobs = [(case,bench.MODELS[index],index) for number,case in enumerate(ordered) for index in ([0,1] if number%2==0 else [1,0])]
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(bench.run_case,case,model,index,key,endpoint,{'questions':questions},RUN,manifest_hash) for case,model,index in jobs]
        for count,future in enumerate(concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures),1):
            record=future.result()
            print(count,'/ 280',record['case_id'],record['requested_model'],record.get('error') or record['verdict']['status'],flush=True)
    make_report(cases,questions,manifest)


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
